summary: All 8 acceptance criteria (post-refactor hooks/memoization/component-split checks) exercised via browser checks. No API-bearing criteria -- app is static, frontend-only data-driven. 8 passed, 0 failed.

checks.criterion: Homepage memoized journey filters update from current selections without stale state
checks.name: home-duration-filter-updates-results
checks.evidence: filter-duration=10+ Days shows 'Japan, in detail' and 'The Open Horizon', hides 'Bali Escape' (count 0); filter-duration=3-5 Days then shows 'A City in a Garden' (Singapore).

checks.criterion: Traveller review carousel state remains responsive after hook refactor
checks.name: review-carousel-navigation
checks.evidence: traveller-stories-section starts on 'Nandita & Arjun'; review-next-button advances to 'Aarav Menon' then 'The Kapur family'; review-previous-button returns to 'Aarav Menon'. Section remained rendered throughout.

checks.criterion: Destination listing memoized category filtering updates correctly
checks.name: destination-category-filter
checks.evidence: destination-filter-visa-free shows destination-card-thailand, hides destination-card-switzerland (count 0); destination-filter-domestic shows kashmir/kerala/rajasthan/goa cards, hides destination-card-japan (count 0).

checks.criterion: Dynamic destination state resets cleanly between routes
checks.name: destination-variant-resets-on-route-change
checks.evidence: On /destinations/japan selected itinerary-select-japan-slow -> heading 'Japan, Slowly' visible; navigated to /destinations/australia -> itineraries-section heading 'Australia Short Escape' visible and 'Japan, Slowly' heading count 0 (state reset via key={destination.slug}).

checks.criterion: Desktop navigation remains functional after component split
checks.name: nav-mega-menu-hover-bridge
checks.evidence: Hovered nav-explore-destinations-button, moved mouse across bridge into mega-menu-japan-link, menu stayed visible; click navigated to /destinations/japan.

checks.criterion: Mobile navigation remains functional after component split
checks.name: mobile-nav-menu-links
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport, mobile-nav-menu-button opened sheet showing mobile-menu-destinations-link, mobile-menu-about-link, mobile-menu-contact-link and mobile-menu-featured-destinations; clicking mobile-menu-about-link navigated to /about.

checks.criterion: Itinerary variants and timeline interactions remain intact
checks.name: destination-itinerary-variant-switch
checks.evidence: On /destinations/japan, itinerary-options has 3 buttons; default aside heading 'Japan Short Escape'; selecting itinerary-select-japan-slow updates heading to 'Japan, Slowly' and price text changed; itinerary-day-toggle-02 aria-expanded flipped false->true revealing itinerary-day-02.

checks.criterion: Route scroll reset remains intact after hook extraction
checks.name: scroll-restoration-on-route-change
checks.evidence: Scrolled homepage to scrollY>1000, clicked Bali link (a[href='/destinations/bali']), landed on /destinations/bali with scrollY<50.

action_items: No backend test artifacts were created: server.py exposes only a generic /api/ health route; none of the 8 acceptance criteria depend on API/DB behavior -- all data (journeys, itineraries, destinations, reviews) is static TS data bundled into the frontend. Verified via `python -m pytest` (no tests collected, confirming no API-bearing criteria) and a healthy GET /api/ (200).
